issues_in: Status tier inconsistency: `status_as_of_cutoff` starts with the tier label "approved-permitted" but the entry itself and NOTES.md 2026-08-11 state no Improvement Location Permit,
fixed: data.json `status_as_of_cutoff`: qualified the tier label to "approved-permitted (design-review / primary-plat level) as of 2026-08-11" and clarified that the 2026-01-05 Plainfield Plan Commission action is local design-review (DP-25-088) and primary-plat (PP-25-094) approval only, with no Improvement Location Permit, building permit, construction start, energized service, or occupancy evidence located in this refresh (mirrors sibling convention in usdc-0009 / usdc-0084).

NOTES.md: added a dated 2026-08-11 re-check bullet to the ## 2026-08-11 refresh section documenting the status-label qualification with source URLs (Town of Plainfield project page, Plan Commission Projects index, staff report PDF).
remaining_risks: SKILL.md line 4 one-liner still reads "no status" (stale 2026-07-16 baseline text); the review issue did not flag SKILL.md for this center, so it was left untouched per brief - parent may decide to refresh it.

data.json has no `history` key (63 of 208 usdc entries lack it, e.g. usdc-0007, usdc-0026); the review did not flag history for this center, so it was left as-is to keep the fix scoped to the exact issue.

The inventory.json issue string for this center is truncated in the inventory itself (ends "...state no Improvement Location Permit, "); the intended full issue text was inferred from the entry and NOTES.md.
summary: Fixed the status tier inconsistency by qualifying status_as_of_cutoff to "approved-permitted (design-review / primary-plat level)" with explicit prose that the 2026-01-05 Plan Commission action covered design review DP-25-088 and primary plat PP-25-094 only, and that no Improvement Location Permit, building permit, construction start, energized service, or occupancy evidence was located; added a dated 2026-08-11 NOTES.md bullet with source URLs. data.json validated as valid JSON after the edit; no URL spot-checks were needed because no URL issue was flagged for this center.
